prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop homepage comp for fcullmann.com, approximately 1440 × 1000 landscape
Primary request: Design a shippable, high-end personal software-engineer website screen with strict magazine/index navigation. The opening must feel like an Emigre-era bitmap type specimen translated into a confident digital product: a coarse bitmap display statement “BUILD USEFUL THINGS.” occupies roughly half of the opening composition, while crisp sans-serif interface typography preserves readability. Balance the statement with a real, usable JSON Formatter working specimen. Continue below into a dense numbered “Featured Tools” issue index, with “Latest writing” visibly beginning in the viewport.
Scene/backdrop: full-bleed website canvas only, no device frame and no browser chrome
Subject: Desktop homepage. At top, a fine editorial masthead/navigation with “Florian Ullmann — Senior Software Engineer”, “Tools”, “Writing”, “About”. Opening section uses a rigorous asymmetric grid: giant pixel-display “BUILD USEFUL THINGS.” on one side; a practical JSON Formatter on the other with a labeled JSON input textarea containing plausible sample JSON, a signal-red “Format JSON” action, and a clean formatted output/code specimen. Below, a tightly ruled numbered index headed “Featured Tools” containing “01 JSON Formatter”, “02 Base64”, “03 UUID Generator”, with concise functional descriptors and restrained directional marks. The next section title “Latest writing” must be visible near the bottom.
Style/medium: realistic polished product UI mockup, not concept art and not poster art; early digital design magazine, Emigre bitmap type specimen, Swiss editorial grid discipline, digital-native confidence rather than nostalgic novelty
Composition/framing: wide desktop viewport, straight-on, approximately 1440 × 1000; dense but usable layout; disciplined alignment; fine rules; clear interaction hierarchy; opening occupies about two-thirds of the screen and lower index continues naturally below
Lighting/mood: flat screen-native presentation, crisp and assured
Color palette: newsprint #F2F0EB, ink #0A0A0A, signal red #E5011A, acid green #A4FF3F; color used sparingly as functional emphasis
Materials/textures: subtle newsprint tooth, visible square pixels in the display lettering, controlled halftone accents only; crisp UI controls and sharp editorial rules
Text (verbatim): “Florian Ullmann — Senior Software Engineer”; “Tools”; “Writing”; “About”; “BUILD USEFUL THINGS.”; “JSON Formatter”; “Format JSON”; “Featured Tools”; “01 JSON Formatter”; “02 Base64”; “03 UUID Generator”; “Latest writing”
Constraints: Render the listed text accurately and no additional brand slogan. The JSON formatter must look genuinely usable, with clear input, button, and formatted code output. Keep body copy legible in a clean sans-serif. Use square corners and practical spacing. The result must unmistakably read as a real deployable website screen.
Avoid: rounded Bootstrap cards, generic SaaS design, fake portrait, fake metrics, gradients, glossy 3D, device frame, browser chrome, watermark, illegible microtype, decorative poster-only composition, vintage kitsch, excessive distressing
